title: Sewage Pumping System

introduction.definition: A sewage pumping (lift) station collects wastewater flowing by gravity into a wet well and pumps it through a rising main to a higher sewer or treatment plant. Two submersible non-clog pumps on guide rails run duty/standby under float or level control; check and gate valves in a separate valve chamber allow each pump to be serviced.
key_points: Wet-well volume limits motor starts per hour
Self-cleansing velocity in the rising main
H₂S safety: ventilation and gas detection

classification.application: Municipal and building wastewater, storm water

introduction.summary: A sewage lift station collects wastewater flowing by gravity into a wet well and pumps it up through a rising main to a higher sewer or treatment plant. Submersible non-clog pumps sit on the wet-well floor on guide rails, so they can be lifted out without entering the well. Float switches (or a level transmitter) start the duty pump at a set level, start the standby pump if the level keeps rising, stop the pumps at the low level and raise a high-level alarm. Non-return and isolation valves in a separate valve chamber allow each pump to be serviced while the other keeps running.

video_tutorials.title: Sewage Pumping System — Introduction

script.narration: This module introduces the Sewage Pumping System.
A sewage pumping (lift) station collects wastewater flowing by gravity into a wet well and pumps it through a rising main to a higher sewer or treatment plant.
Two submersible non-clog pumps on guide rails run duty/standby under float or level control; check and gate valves in a separate valve chamber allow each pump to be serviced.
Typical applications include municipal sewerage networks; industrial and refinery effluent collection; storm water; building and campus drainage.

The cutaway reveals the internal construction: Duty Submersible Pump (Volute + Motor Housing), Duty Pump – Rotor & Shaft, Duty Pump – Non-Clog Impeller, Standby Submersible Pump (Volute + Motor Housing).
The exploded view separates every component so each one can be tapped for its function, material and failure modes.
Next, watch the operation tutorial to see how it works.

video_tutorials.title: Sewage Pumping System — Maintenance

script.narration: Maintenance essentials for the Sewage Pumping System.
Check run hours and alarms.
Clean wet well and screen basket.
Exercise valves.
Lift pumps; check seals and impellers.
Watch for pump clogging: high current, low flow. Common cause: wipes, rags.
Watch for septicity and odour: h₂s. Common cause: long retention.
Watch for float failure: overflow or dry run. Common cause: fat build-up.
Record every inspection so trends — vibration, temperature, leakage and performance — can be compared over time.
